title: Separation of Recruitment Eligibility and Vacancy Applicability Contract
problemStatement: In 48CS2R1, having zero matching vacancies forced matchResultState to NOT_ELIGIBLE, falsely implying legal disqualification.

dimensions.definition: Evaluates statutory criteria (education, age, domicile, discipline).
Evaluates availability of vacancies for the candidate reservation/quota profile.

useCaseDemonstration.scenario: Candidate meets all educational, age, and domicile criteria, but current recruitment only advertises SC/ST special backlog vacancies.
useCaseDemonstration.rulesOutcome: All rules passed (AGE_MAX passed, QUALIFICATION_MIN passed).

engineOutput.userMessage: You meet all eligibility requirements for this recruitment. However, no vacancies are currently advertised for your category quota bucket.
